title: Ignored binary is absent from Docker build context
root_cause: The build excludes container/bin through .dockerignore while the Dockerfile tries to copy a binary from that directory. Docker therefore cannot checksum the COPY source even though the directory exists in the checkout.

relevant_evidence.why: The binary directory is excluded from the build context.
The image requires a source inside the excluded directory.
BuildKit reports that the COPY source is missing.
